description_zh: Zoox 自动驾驶车辆（ego）在 Embarcadero 街南行方向以低速跟随车流时，被后方 Nissan Frontier（v2）低速追尾。根据定性词“low speed”为 ego 与后车均设为 5 m/s；后车行为选用 rear_hit 原语表达同车道后方碰撞。

source_snippets: A Zoox vehicle in autonomy was stopped with brake lights illuminated in traffic southbound on Embarcadero Street towards Folsom Street.
When traffic ahead began to move the Zoox vehicle was appropriately following the car ahead at low speed when it was rear ended by Vehicle #2 at low speed.
evidence.reason: 两车均移动（Zoox 低速跟车，后车移动追尾），选择被追尾的 Zoox 作为 ego 以便使用 rear_hit 原语；后车行为以 behind_same_lane 位置 + rear_hit 表达追尾。
